title: Servo Motion: Pulses, Power and Angles
summary: Learn how a pulse sets a servo's angle, why servos need their own 5 V supply with a shared ground, and sweep one servo with the ESP32Servo library.

concepts.name: PWM: pulse width sets the angle
Controlling a servo angle with the ESP32Servo library

milestone: One servo, powered from a separate 5 V supply with a shared ground, sweeps safely between 10 and 170 degrees under your code.
